test_title: PYST 27: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment in the following sentence.**

The __proud people__ forget the fact that the world is tangible.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**High and mighty**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**High and mighty**" is an idiom that means arrogant or haughty. (अभिमानी)

 
 
• **Example**: *After winning the championship, he became high and mighty, treating his teammates with condescension.*
